description.full: The \"kidney thieves\" urban legend represents one of the most pervasive and geographically widespread contemporary legends of the late 20th and early 21st centuries. This narrative typically involves a person (usually a traveler or bar patron) who wakes up in a bathtub filled with ice, discovering a surgical incision and a note indicating that one or both kidneys have been stolen for the black market organ trade. This legend emerged in the early 1990s and has been exhaustively investigated by journalists, law enforcement, medical professionals, and folklorists. Despite decades of circulation, no verified case of this scenario occurring has ever been documented. The legend serves as a modern morality tale reflecting anxieties about travel, strangers, bodily autonomy, and the commodification of the human body in contemporary society.
